-def utc_timestamp(text):return 0
+def utc_timestamp(text):
+    # Parse an ISO 8601 datetime. A required explicit timezone is required,
+    # so the string must contain a timezone. The "Z" suffix denotes UTC.
+    return int(time.mktime(_parse_iso8601(text)))
+
+
+def _parse_iso8601(text):
+    # Convert an ISO 8601 datetime string to an integer Unix timestamp in
+    # UTC.
+    if "Z" in text:
+        return _parse_iso8601(text.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+
+    parts = text.split(":")
+    if len(parts) == 1:
+        parts = parts + [""]
+    parts = parts[:2]
+    if len(parts) == 2:
+        if len(parts[1]) == 0:
+            return _parse_iso8601(parts[0])
+        return _parse_iso8601(parts[0] + ":" + parts[1])
+
+    return _parse_iso8601("".join(parts))
+
